Then it resets the pit lane garage index (car record +0xe0) of all 27 car records [mgr+0x938+id*0x10] to 0x7fffffff (0x1434b56bc..0x1434b5876), then per entrant (vector [[mgr+0xb70]+0x1d8..+0x1e0], stride 0x98, vehicle id +0x82, ids > 0x1a skipped at 0x1434b58e3): garage = 2 x team garage slot ([e+0x88]+0x28) + seat (e+0x90) when the track byte [[[mgr+0xb80]+0x1a8]+0x30]+0x60 (copied to mgr+0xc29, tested 0x1434b591a; its only other reader, Game_PitLane_MoveDownSpline at 0x1434beb6c, flips the sign of a float with mask 0x80000000 when it is 0) is set, else (2 x slot | 1) - seat (per V11203 polarity correction; H: garage order flag of the track); safety-car vehicles (list [mgr+0xb38]+0x30..+0x38) get 0x63 (99).
